label: Page — About
description: The newsroom and how the Ledger reports.

settings.heading: News for the valley since 1962
settings.standfirst: Eleven reporters above the mill, a paper every day, and corrections printed where you can find them.

settings.heading: A newsroom above the mill
settings.body:
Eleven reporters, two photographers and one editor work from the second floor of the old mill, a short walk from the bridge.

We publish every day and print a weekend edition that still sells out at the station kiosk.

settings.heading: How we report
settings.body:
The Daily Ledger has covered the valley since 1962. We publish every weekday and update stories as they change, with the date of each update printed under the headline.

Every story names its reporter and its sources. When we get something wrong, we correct it in the story and say what changed at the foot of the page.

What we cover

  • Politics and the council, from the agenda to the vote
  • Business on the high street and at the mill
  • Weather, the river and the roads they close

Read our corrections policy, or write to the newsroom with a story we should be chasing.

settings.text: The morning's six stories in your inbox by seven, every weekday. Free.
